name: Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A.
summary: Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A. provides health services in Chile. It offers patient information and exams instruction, and online services; specialties services; and outpatient services including urgency, laboratory, imaging, vaccination, blood bank, outpatient procedures, and reproductive medicine unit. The company also provides hospitalization services, such as maternity, adult and pediatric hospitalization, adult critical patient unit, pavilion and surgical procedures, neonatology, and robotic surgery; and telemedicine services comprising online consultation and rehabilitation.
